_help: This file controls the words on the Regina Data Map: the opening message, the six story buttons and the 'Did you know?' facts.

Edit it on GitHub (open the file, press the pencil icon, change the text, press 'Commit changes'). The next map refresh publishes it and every downloaded copy picks it up the next time it is opened online.
Words in {curly brackets} are filled in with live numbers every time the map opens, so they never go stale. Text inside [[double square brackets]] only appears if every {number} inside it exists.

Story 'show' options: groups (which types of work to show; leave out for all), min (smallest declared value in dollars), span (days of permits to show; 30 = last 30 days), events (true = show rezonings and applications instead of permits).
The full list of {numbers} you can use is in the repository file CONTENT-GUIDE.md. A fact that uses a number the map doesn't know is skipped.

intro.title: Click anything
intro.body: Every dot is a building permit the City issued. Pick a story, slide through time since {first_year}, press play to watch Regina grow, or hit Surprise me.

facts: In the 12 months to {latest} the City issued {permits_12m} building permits with {value_12m} of declared construction value. That is about {per_day_12m} permits every working day.
Busiest neighbourhood by number of permits: {top_hood_count_12m} ({top_hood_count_12m_n}).
Most new homes permitted: {top_hood_homes_12m}, about {top_hood_homes_12m_n} of them.
The single biggest permit: {biggest_what_12m} at {biggest_address_12m} ({biggest_hood_12m}), declared at {biggest_value_12m}.
Half of all permits are for jobs under {median_12m}. Most building in Regina is small renovation work, not towers.
The City issues the most permits on {busiest_weekday}s ({busiest_weekday_n} in the last year).
{laneway_12m} backyard or laneway suites were permitted in the last 12 months.
Since {since} the City has issued {permits_all} building permits worth {value_all}. Use the date controls to travel through all of it.
The biggest full year for declared construction value since {first_year} was {best_year}, at {best_year_value}.
The biggest permit since {first_year}: {biggest_what_all} at {biggest_address_all}, {biggest_value_all}, issued {biggest_date_all}.
Regina grew from {pop_first} people in {pop_first_year} to {pop_last} in {pop_last_year}, up {pop_growth_pct}% (Statistics Canada).
Average rent for a purpose-built rental unit in Regina was {rent_last} in {rent_last_year}, and {vacancy_last} of units were empty (CMHC).

In {tax_year} the City and Library charge {tax_res_100k} in property tax on every $100,000 of a home's assessed value. Commercial and industrial property pays {tax_com_more_pct}% more per dollar of assessed value ({tax_com_100k}). The Province's education tax is extra.
